Noah (Marketing): Heads up: we want a tight reproducible datapoint for the launch blog that shows cost/latency tradeoff between fp16 and int8 for demo flows. Not a full benchmark but something we can reproduce.

Asha (Runtime): Clear. Which demo flow and what precision knobs?

Noah (Marketing): Demo flow is the interactive Q&A script in /drive/launch-demo-qna.json (~60 sessions). Compare fp16 vs int8 (no mixing). We need: tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99, and an annotated note on any visible quality regressions. Also capture coldstart timeline for first 10 minutes.

Dom (Perf): I'll log batch sizes, CPU steal, and memory pressure. Also can generate a small delta table comparing outputs for 5 canonical prompts.

Noah (Marketing): Timeline: results uploaded to s3 by Tuesday AM so docs team can start drafting. Keep the run minimal: 2 runs per precision, warm = 10 synth + 20 real.

Asha (Runtime): Plan: 2x2 runs, produce metrics.csv, coldstart.png, delta-samples.json, run-notes.txt. We'll add one-line caveats per artifact. If int8 fails on >1 node we'll fallback to mixed and log that.

ci-bot: Run submitted: r-20260502-aa9b.

Maya (Marketing Lead): Add: include approximate per-route cost (rounded cents) and an estimate of percentage cost reduction from fp16->int8. We might use that in a side-by-side bullet.

Asha (Runtime): Acknowledged. We'll compute cost using current pricing and include it in run-notes.

Noah (Marketing): Thanks. If any unexpected deltas appear ping us immediately.
